title: MHADA lottery results 2026 today: When, where and how to check draw status for Mumbai's 2,640 budget homes
content:
• The Maharashtra Housing and Area Development Authority (MHADA) lottery 2026 results for 2,640 tenements in Mumbai were announced on 06 August 2026.
• MHADA received a total of 97,613 applications for the scheme, with 69,526 applicants transferring Earnest Money Deposits (EMDs) by 29 May 2026.
• Apartment prices range from over ₹29 lakh for Economic Weaker Section (EWS) homes in Mankhurd/Goregaon to ₹6.82 crore for High Income Group (HIG) apartments in Tardeo, South Mumbai.

title: Uttarakhand poll panel chief Purushottam gets SIR notice over mismatch in electoral records: Report
content:
• Uttarakhand's Chief Electoral Officer (CEO) BVRC Purushottam received a notice regarding a discrepancy in his name during the ongoing Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls.
• The CEO directed district election officers to conduct hearings on notices issued during the SIR at the homes of differently-abled voters and senior citizens aged 65 and above.
• Approximately 19 lakh notices, accounting for about 77% of the total, have been served on voters across the state since the publication of the draft electoral roll on July 14, with hearings continuing until September 3.

title: Petrol, diesel prices today — 6 Aug: Fuel rates in Delhi, Bengaluru, Jaipur as Crude oil dips on US-Iran deal optimism
content:
• Domestic retail petrol and diesel prices in India remained unchanged as of 6 August, aligning with the last major price revision that occurred over two months ago, on 25 May.
• Global benchmark Brent crude price traded near $79 a barrel, while West Texas Intermediate fell to below $75 per barrel on 6 August, driven by optimism over a potential US-Iran deal.
• The Society of Indian Automobile Manufacturers (SIAM) withdrew a letter written to the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas, which had flagged concerns over contamination of E20 fuel, pending further data authentication.

title: Proposed Iran-Oman deal could hand Tehran control over incoming ships, report says
content:
• A proposed agreement between Iran and Oman would grant Tehran control over inbound commercial shipping through the Strait of Hormuz.
• Iran is seeking to charge shipping fees ranging from 5% to 7% of cargo value for vessels using the Strait of Hormuz, while Oman proposes lower fees around 3%.
• The Strait of Hormuz previously carried around one-fifth of the world's oil and liquefied natural gas shipments.

title: Trump says Strait of Hormuz deal could come this week as Iran and Oman finalize draft to reopen shipping route
content:
• A draft agreement between Iran and Oman to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, a critical shipping lane, is awaiting final approval from Iran's Supreme Leader Ayatollah Mojtaba Khamenei.
• The Strait of Hormuz, before its disruption, carried approximately one-fifth of the world's oil and natural gas exports, highlighting its vital role in global energy markets.
• Amidst negotiations for reopening the Strait of Hormuz, Brent crude oil prices were trading around $80 per barrel on Wednesday.

title: Niti Aayog proposes national caregiving policy, regulator to build India's care economy
content:
• Niti Aayog has proposed a National Policy on Caregiving and the establishment of a National Caregiver Council, which is likely to function under the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship.
• India's care services market, estimated at $29.62 billion in 2023, is projected to reach $72.31 billion by 2030, aligning with the elderly population expected to more than double from 149 million in 2022 to 347 million by 2050.
• The World Health Organization (WHO) projects a global shortage of 11 million health and care workers by 2030, creating opportunities for India to emerge as a global supplier of trained caregiving professionals.

title: RBI plans to roll out polymer banknotes by FY28
content:
• The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) is planning to roll out polymer banknotes by FY28 (2027-28) after conducting a pilot program.
• RBI is focusing on introducing polymer banknotes for lower denominations like ₹10 and ₹20 due to their higher circulation and shorter lifespan, which polymer can significantly improve.
• Bharatiya Reserve Bank Note Mudran (RBI's currency management arm) issued a global Expression of Interest (EoI) on July 17, with the bidding window open until August 18, 2026, for supplying around 68,000 reams of polymer substrate.

title: Supreme Court says listening to youngsters is the ‘biggest powerful source’ to curb protest violence: ‘Forces should….'
content:
• A Supreme Court bench comprising Chief Justice of India (CJI) Surya Kant, Justice Joymalya Bagchi, and Justice V Mohana, made observations on handling student protests.
• The Supreme Court was hearing a petition seeking action against the 'Cockroach Janta Party (CJP)' for its alleged involvement in violence during recent protests in Delhi and other parts of the country.
• The Supreme Court orally remarked that engaging with the concerns of young demonstrators and exercising restraint by authorities is the 'most effective way' to deal with unrest during student protests.

title: Rural development ministry to use AI to rank states on audit performance
content:
• The rural development ministry will use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to rank states based on their performance in responding to internal audit observations.
• For FY27, the rural development ministry has been allocated ₹2.31 trillion for flagship programmes, including ₹95,692.31 crore for Viksit Bharat–Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission.
• The new AI-enabled audit system shifts internal audits from a compliance-driven exercise to a risk-based management system by digitising the entire audit lifecycle.
